QuestInfo.1:
From the moment you arrived in the 'Land of Warriors,' you found yourself under siege. Upon winning the battle, the locals took to calling you by the title 'Greatest Warrior Ever.' 

It seems that with this title comes the responsibility of controlling the passage of time between night and day. They have asked you to bring down the sun by cranking the handle on the pulley in the middle of town.
